content.title: Chapter 2 - ADMINISTRATION — Sec. 2-77. - Compensation for certain board and commission members.
content.summary:
Members of the planning commission shall receive $100.00 for each regular or special
               meeting attended; members of the board of adjustment shall receive $100.00 for each
               regular or special meeting attended.
(Code 1981, § 2-14; Ord. No. 2123, § 1, 11-19-1984; Ord. No. 250…
